specs.title: an administrator writes, studies and approves an answer; members then see it
imported AI drafts are labelled and wait for approval
content reviewers can write drafts but not approve them
asks a question and shows the explanation apart from the original source text
says clearly when the constitution does not answer the question
offers suggested questions taken from the constitution’s own titles
invoice → owner reports payment → Super Admin verifies by hand → receipt
members of a suspended organisation are told the portal is unavailable
with AI off, finds the matching clauses word for word instead of asking an AI
with AI off, says clearly when no clause matches
rejects a wrong password with a clear message
sends signed-out visitors to the sign-in page
super admin sees live overview figures and system health
super admin creates an organisation and manages subscription, branding and status
support access to content requires a reason and is recorded
an organisation administrator cannot use the control centre
the control centre is usable on a small screen
upload, check, approve and publish a document; members only see it once published
save for offline reading, read and search offline, then sync when back online
the Ask page explains that live AI does not work offline
signing out removes the saved copy from the device
each organisation has its own branded sign-in page from the same code
a member reads, navigates and searches the constitution
members of one organisation cannot open another organisation's portal
members do not get the manage area, and the API refuses their changes
an administrator changes branding, and unsafe content stays harmless
a content reviewer sees the approval status of every version
large bottom navigation and a Contents button make the portal easy to use
not signed in pages fit a phone screen
